title: Agent Chat: tool-policy / confirmation layer for destructive ops in the autonomous loop
description: RESOLVED per user decision (overrides original 'confirmation layer' framing): the destructive *_remove commands (stage_remove/library_remove/timeline_remove_layer/_frame/scene_remove) + file_save_fla + publish_swf stay auto-running in the agent-chat loop (all undoable via pushDoc). Fix = REMOVE doc_load + file_load_fla from the AGENT-CHAT tool set only (no allowlist/confirmation layer). Implementation: packages/authoring-ui/src/agentchat/tools.ts adds named denylist constant AGENT_CHAT_EXCLUDED_COMMANDS = Set(['doc_load','file_load_fla']) with a comment citing the user decision; buildAgentTools() skips those names so they are never registered as tools the chat LLM can call (loop iterates ALL_COMMANDS, 'continue' on excluded). AgentToolSet type widened to Partial<Record<...>>. systemPrompt.ts adds one line telling the model it cannot load/replace the document. Scope is agentchat/ only — packages/authoring-ui/src/agent/registry.ts (programmatic MCP/JSFL path) is UNCHANGED and still serves doc_load/file_load_fla. Test: tools.test.ts new case asserts tools.doc_load/file_load_fla === undefined and tools.stage_remove/publish_swf/file_save_fla/scene_remove/timeline_remove_layer defined; coverage test now compares against EXPOSED_COMMANDS (73 of 75). Docs: docs/32-agent-chat.md updated. VERIFY: pnpm --filter './packages/**' build = Done (8 pkgs). pnpm --filter @flash/authoring-ui run test = 102 files, 1214 tests passed.
